about: Kingsville is a town in Essex County, Ontario, on Lake Erie west of Leamington. It mixes a historic main street, marina harbour, and surrounding greenhouse and vineyard country. Jack Miner’s bird sanctuary heritage and easy access to Point Pelee’s western approaches shape its visitor profile. About 22,000 people live in Kingsville.
